candidateEvaluations.strategy: Direct Statement Credit Focus: Emphasizes points balance, cashback tracking, and immediate one-tap statement credit application for bill reduction, fully aligning with payment utility preferences without any gamification.
Goal-Linked Savings Integration: Focuses on tracking progress toward the 'Holiday Spending Money' goal with clear monetary breakdowns and automatic reward allocation options.

approvedCustomerStory.storyTitle: Apply Statement Credit for Bill Reduction
approvedCustomerStory.oneSentenceStory: Customer checks current coin balance and cashback to allocate rewards directly to statement credit.
approvedCustomerStory.customerSituation: Customer visits mobile app to review rewards standing and current goal progress.
approvedCustomerStory.storyTension: Ensuring transparent coin-to-conversion rates without encountering irrelevant vouchers or gamification.
approvedCustomerStory.customerResolution: Direct, frictionless application of accumulated rewards as a statement credit on the linked card.
approvedCustomerStory.primaryOutcome: Effortless tracking and application of statement credits for bill reduction.

journeyCandidates.journeyObjective: Provide clear rewards overview and frictionless statement credit application for bill reduction.
journeyCandidates.completionDefinition: Customer views balance/cashback and successfully applies or allocates statement credit.
episodeSketches: Episode 1: Display points balance (7,300 coins) and cashback earned clearly at the top.
Episode 2: Show active holiday goal progress and tangible value conversion.
Episode 3: Provide one-tap statement credit application action.

journeyCandidates.journeyObjective: Goal-centric rewards review highlighting holiday savings progress and automatic allocation.
journeyCandidates.completionDefinition: Customer reviews goal milestones and confirms allocation settings.
episodeSketches: Episode 1: Highlight Holiday Spending Money goal progress (53%).
Episode 2: Present tangible value breakdown supporting the goal.
Episode 3: Confirm automatic reward allocation settings.
